messages:
Priya: Heads up — kicking off prod rollout v2.14 for model-service in change window (02:00-03:00 UTC). Pin policy: shadow then canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Pin fallback: v2.13.

Priya: Abort conditions: p95 latency > 120ms sustained for 3 minutes, error rate > 3% across infra, or visible regression on eval set. Runbooks: https://rwd.infra/runbooks/rollback-model-service and https://rwd.infra/runbooks/kill-switch

deploy-bot: Deploy started for model-service @canary (5 replicas). build: 2.14. checks: smoke, schema

Sam: Who's owning the backout if we hit thresholds? :thinking_face:

Priya: Raj (oncall) primary, Mia backup. I'll coordinate release notes & postmortem.

Raj: Oncall — monitoring dashboards up. I'll watch latency/errors. Ping me @pager for immediate action.

oncall-bot: Canary metrics snapshot — p50: 40ms, p95: 88ms, error_rate: 0.7% (1m)

Mia: Noted. I'll keep an eye on the frontends for 502s and correlation.

deploy-bot: Canary 10% complete; 5/5 canaries healthy

Priya: Hold for 10m for stability checks. If anything odd, respond with "abort" and cause.

Mia: Seeing a tiny spike in errors from frontend cluster eu-west-1 — 4.1% over the last 60s. Correlating with model-service canary.

Raj: Copy. Going to trigger partial rollback plan 1 (drain canary + pin). Steps:
1) run: rwdctl rollout drain --service model-service --selector canary
2) pin traffic: rwdctl traffic pin --service model-service --version v2.13
3) create incident stub and mark change window aborted

Raj: Executing step 1 now.

Raj: ```
$ rwdctl rollout drain --service model-service --selector canary
draining 5 pods... OK
```

deploy-bot: Drain complete — 5 pods terminated, new pods not scheduled for v2.14

Raj: Executing step 2.

Raj: ```
$ rwdctl traffic pin --service model-service --version v2.13 --reason "canary error spike"
Traffic pinned to v2.13
```

deploy-bot: Traffic pin applied. All new requests routed to v2.13.

oncall-bot: Post-action metrics (1m) — p95: 45ms, error_rate: 0.6%

Mia: Frontend errors dropped back to baseline. Nice.

Priya: Great. I'm opening a hotfix branch to investigate model-vectorization change. Will revert the model code and run extended evals before reattempt.

Sam: For the postmortem, can you note the abort criteria we hit? I'll draft the release note update: "Rollout paused due to elevated frontend error rate tied to model-service canary; traffic pinned to v2.13."

Priya: Yes. Tagging owners: @Raj, @Mia. Please add short timeline to the incident doc: https://rwd.infra/incidents/2025-03-model-service-canary

Raj: Incident doc updated with timestamps and commands run.

deploy-bot: Change window closed early by Priya. All done.

Priya: Thanks everyone. We'll re-run canary after fix and extended evals. Closing thread.
